_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that facilitates secure, reliable and efficient global commerce and money movement.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (since the FY2020 10-K none carries the earlier sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; GENAI (live from 2022-11-30) is out of scope: its registered scope names no payments network, and the 10-K's competition words on it concern Visa's value-added services ('The integration of technology like GenAI can create new and better offerings that compete with our value-added services, such as strengthened risk monitoring and managing digital identification.'), not the network; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa

theme_watch.reason: Live: Visa's own FY2025 10-K says 'The global payments industry is undergoing significant and rapid technological change, including increased proliferation of mobile and other proximity and in-app payment technologies, ecommerce, tokenization, cryptocurrencies, distributed ledger and blockchain technologies, cloud-based encryption and authorization, and new authentication technologies such as biometrics, FIDO 2.0, 3D Secure 2.0 and dynamic cardholder verification values or dCVV2.' It names a crypto offering of its own: 'We have provided both the on-ramp and off-ramp platform for buying and spending crypto assets and stablecoins through cards.' The stock trades at 31.4x FY26E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of Visa's network specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that facilitates secure, reliable and efficient global commerce and money movement.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (since the FY2020 10-K none carries the earlier sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; GENAI (live from 2022-11-30) is out of scope: its registered scope names no payments network, and the 10-K's competition words on it concern Visa's value-added services ('The integration of technology like GenAI can create new and better offerings that compete with our value-added services, such as strengthened risk monitoring and managing digital identification.'), not the network; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.76x; +36% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.15; conservative 2yr +24%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.1%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.9%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.9%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2026-02-27) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.76x (35.7% downside to Bear $206.00 / +46.7% upside to Bull $469.78) | Adj composite 2.18 vs market 2.33: gap -0.15 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +36% above the EPP floor $234.60 (23x FY26E $10.20) | Conservative 2-yr case: +23.7% total (+11.9%/yr) | At 31.4x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $423.39 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +14.6% YoY in Q1 FY26, forward revenues +14.6% (Q1 FY26 revenue growth (no FY26 revenue range)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
